error.message: ASAR header/index admission is limited to 16 MiB / 16777216 bytes. On MCP, call update_analysis_settings with setting asar.max_header_bytes, action set, and a value in bytes up to 256 MiB / 268435456 bytes (default 16 MiB / 16777216 bytes), then retry the original request. It applies to the next operation without restarting REA. For CLI or future REA processes, set REA_ASAR_MAX_HEADER_BYTES in the launch environment. Selecting fewer sources or narrowing an internal path does not bypass header admission, because the archive index is read before any member can be selected. Raising max_heap_mb or available host memory does not raise it. Alternatively, analyze an extracted application directory, which does not admit an ASAR header. Repeating the unchanged request fails the same way.
